an6.45:2.1: yampi bhikkhave daḷiddo assako anaddhiko iṇaṃ ādiyati iṇādānampi bhikkhave dukkhaṃ lokasmiṃ kāmabhoginoti
an6.45:3.1: yampi bhikkhave daḷiddo assako anaddhiko iṇaṃ ādiyitvā vaḍḍhiṃ paṭissuṇāti vaḍḍhipi bhikkhave dukkhā lokasmiṃ kāmabhoginoti
an6.45:4.1: yampi bhikkhave daḷiddo assako anaddhiko vaḍḍhiṃ paṭissuṇitvā kālābhataṃ vaḍḍhiṃ na deti codentipi naṃ
an6.45:5.1: yampi bhikkhave daḷiddo assako anaddhiko codiyamāno na deti anucarantipi naṃ
an6.45:6.1: yampi bhikkhave daḷiddo assako anaddhiko anucariyamāno na deti bandhantipi naṃ
an6.45:7.1: iti kho bhikkhave daḷiddiyampi dukkhaṃ lokasmiṃ kāmabhogino iṇādānampi dukkhaṃ lokasmiṃ kāmabhogino vaḍḍhipi dukkhā lokasmiṃ kāmabhogino codanāpi dukkhā lokasmiṃ kāmabhogino anucariyāpi dukkhā lokasmiṃ kāmabhogino bandhanampi dukkhaṃ lokasmiṃ kāmabhogino
an6.45:7.2: evameva kho bhikkhave yassa kassaci saddhā natthi kusalesu dhammesu hirī natthi kusalesu dhammesu ottappaṃ natthi kusalesu dhammesu viriyaṃ natthi kusalesu dhammesu paññā natthi kusalesu dhammesu
an6.45:7.3: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave ariyassa vinaye daḷiddo assako anaddhiko
an6.45:8.1: sakho so bhikkhave daḷiddo assako anaddhiko saddhāya asati kusalesu dhammesu hiriyā asati kusalesu dhammesu ottappe asati kusalesu dhammesu viriye asati kusalesu dhammesu paññāya asati kusalesu dhammesu kāyena duccaritaṃ carati vācāya duccaritaṃ carati manasā duccaritaṃ carati
an6.45:9.1: so tassa kāyaduccaritassa paṭicchādanahetu pāpikaṃ icchaṃ paṇidahati
an6.45:9.2: mā maṃ jaññūti icchati mā maṃ jaññūti saṃkappeti mā maṃ jaññūti vācaṃ bhāsati mā maṃ jaññūti kāyena parakkamati so tassa vacīduccaritassa paṭicachādanahetu …pe… so tassa manoduccaritassa paṭicchādanahetu pāpikaṃ icchaṃ paṇidahati mā maṃ jaññūti icchati mā maṃ jaññūti saṃkappeti mā maṃ jaññūti vācaṃ bhāsati mā maṃ jaññūti kāyena parakkamati
an6.45:11.1: tamenaṃ araññagataṃ vā rukkhamūlagataṃ vā suññāgāragataṃ vā vippaṭisārasahagatā pāpakā akusalavitakkā samudācaranti
an6.45:12.1: sakho so bhikkhave daḷiddo assako anaddhiko kāyena duccaritaṃ caritvā vācāya duccaritaṃ caritvā manasā duccaritaṃ caritvā kāyassa bhedā parammaraṇā nirayabandhane vā bajjhati tiracchānayonibandhane vā
an6.45:12.2: nāhaṃ bhikkhave aññaṃ ekaṃ bandhanaṃ samanupassāmi evaṃdāruṇaṃ evaṃdukkhaṃ evaṃantarāyakaraṃ anuttarassa yogakkhemassa adhigamāya yathayidaṃ bhikkhave nirayabandhanaṃ vā tiracchānayonibandhanaṃ vāti.
